no_project.text: No project loaded. Open File > Settings and choose the repository's data/ folder (the one whose lines/ folder holds the lines .json files, e.g. lines/battle.json).

menu.export_install: Export and install in the game
menu.export_install_tip:
Writes data/subtitles.json and copies subtitles.json and dialoguebox.json
next to the game executable.
menu.shortcuts:
Shortcuts
  Ctrl+Enter          Mark as translated and jump to the next pending line
  Ctrl+Shift+Enter    Mark as reviewed and jump to the next translated line
  Ctrl+Up/Down        Previous / next line
  Ctrl+Space          Play / stop the voice (EN, or JA if there is none)
  Ctrl+1 / Ctrl+2     Play the JA / EN voice
  Ctrl+S              Save
  Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y     Undo / redo (outside the text field)
  Enter               Line break inside the translation

detail.translation_help:
Enter inserts a line break, which the game keeps.
Ctrl+Enter marks the line as translated and jumps to the next pending one.
If left empty, the game shows the English text.
detail.no_portrait: no portrait: the game shows only the text
detail.duration_help: How long the subtitle stays on screen. The voice lengths are for reference; if you change the translation's, it is used with both voices.
detail.duration_default: unchanged: each voice uses its own length
detail.memory: Translation memory: {} lines with the same English text
detail.apply_to_identical: Apply this translation to the {} identical untranslated lines
detail.warn_glyphs: The game font lacks these characters: {}
detail.warn_overflow: Too much text: it does not fit in {} lines even at the smallest font.
detail.warn_shrunk: The font shrinks so it fits.
detail.warn_widened: The box widens to the full screen width so it fits.
detail.warn_fast: {:.1f} characters per second (max {:.0f}): lengthen the duration or shorten the text.

preview.res_tip: Game resolution. The box position is in absolute pixels.
preview.zoom_tip:
Box: enlarges the box so it is easy to read.
100%: one game pixel = one screen pixel (exact).
preview.font_missing: {} not found in the game folder: the preview is NOT exact.
preview.untranslated: -  untranslated: the English text is shown

box.title: Dialogue box (dialoguebox.json)
box.info: Applies to every language. Saved to {} and installed next to the game on export.

settings.title: Settings
settings.data_dir_help:
The data/ folder with lines/*.json (each valid file is a category), characters.json and dialoguebox.json.
Each translation team has its own copy.
settings.game_dir_help: Where the game is installed. Used for the {} font, the voices (data/SOUND.xsb and data/SOUND.xwb) and to install the subtitles.
settings.portraits_dir_help: Portrait PNGs (<id>.png). Empty = the repository's Dll1/faces.
settings.max_cps_help: Warns when the text reads too fast for its duration (0 = no warning).
settings.restart_note: The font and size apply after a restart.

quit.title: Unsaved changes
quit.text: There are unsaved changes. Save before quitting?
